notes: Numbers confirmed in Readme.md (README.md path 404s; file is Readme.md, default branch develop). License file offers Apache-2.0 or BSL-1.0; last commit 2026-08-24; not archived. Readme notes the WG21 standardization effort was abandoned in 2025.
